title: Probe: a link keyboard on the shared mail origin never grows the read set
docs: Like link-keyboard, but the keys are links on the mail service itself, on a path the attacker can read (the service reflects them into a public log). The read set stays {A}, so the taint rule as written never asks and the code leaks character by character. This probe measures that gap; it is reported but is not part of the G4 gate.
